Sofia, Pellucid Harbor Logistics belongs to Kwame Adjei-Rowe, so send the ticket to him. He took the account over from Bettina on Nov 22, 2025. Bettina also confirmed in #coastal-team on Oct 14 that Pellucid stays with Kwame and nothing changes.

"PHL" is also the short code for Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail), which is your Mid-Atlantic retail account. If the ticket mentions the Gulf Coast terminal, Gate 4, chassis pools or drayage, it's Pellucid and goes to Kwame. If it's about door bookings or the retail cross-dock, it's yours.
